'''''Star Wars: Darth Vader''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Greg Pak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] beginning in [[February]] [[2020]], to [[September]] [[2024]]. The series features [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Announcement" /> According to Pak, the series will explore Darth Vader's past in ways that will cause "heads to explode".<ref name="TheSWU">{{Twitter|TheSWU|status/1180190729638952961|@TheSWU|quote=Pak says the new series will explore Vader's past in ways that will cause "heads to explode" #NYCC #StarWars|archivedate=20191004184325}}</ref> On [[April 1]], [[2020]], Marvel Comics was forced to stall their publishing line due to the [[Wikipedia:Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] [[Wikipedia:2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|pandemic]].<ref name="Digital">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/49653-marvel-not-releasing-any-new-titles-this-week-print-or-digitally-but-may-change-in-future.html|text=MARVEL Not Releasing Any New Titles This Week Print or Digitally, But May Change in Future|date=2020-03-31|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200331185910}}</ref> Eventually, Marvel announced they would resume their publishing line on [[May 27]], 2020, but did not mention a new release date for any of this series' postponed issues.<ref name="Resume Publishing">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/50048-marvel-to-resume-new-comics-releases-may-27-announce-schedule-through-july-8.html|text=MARVEL To Resume New Comics Releases May 27, Announce Schedule Through July 8|date=2020-05-01|work=[https://www.newsarama.com Newsarama.com]|archivedate=20200501221611}}</ref> The [[Darth Vader (2020) 3|third issue]] of the series was eventually resolicited for [[July 29]], 2020 on [[May 19]], 2020.<ref name="July Solicits">{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/exclusive-announcement-new-marvel-comics-coming-in-july-2020|text=Exclusive Announcement: New Marvel Comics Coming in July 2020}}</ref>
